issues: 全景是通用灰色小字 dashboard，结果卡只是一格灰卡片里一个大"1"，看不出三步操作产生了什么结果
三个特写（Deploy 按钮 / 开关 / 翻牌）和全景内容没有对应关系，读作三段素材硬拼
特写底是把整页 dashboard 放大虚化，灰白一片，控件材质平
结果只靠一圈靛蓝描边和 "+1" 角标，答案不够亮
changes: look 换成 ember，题材改为虚构智能供暖 App「Hearth」：全景是三张为镜头设计的房间卡（120px 细体温度读数、270° 表盘、电源钮、Boost 开关），橙色只属于"正在加热"
三个特写就是中间卡自己的三个控件，按原生尺寸重画：①电源钮按下亮橙（带机加工金属边框）②Boost 开关拨右（圆钮滑动拉伸 + 双层火苗）③表盘 19°→22°（弧线扫过、刻度点亮、300px 读数跳变）
三镜统一：主体屏心同倍率、同一套暖黑微距散景底（每镜换排布）、镜内极缓推近，左下角「01 POWER / 02 BOOST / 03 SET 22°」步骤号把三连读成一个流程
节奏保持静 4-动 3-静 3 的 10f 咔哒结构，状态在动作窗中点二值跳变；第三声后 7f poly(5) whip，上一镜甩出画左、全景从右甩入，按速度横向运动模糊
结果：中间卡弹簧抬起 + 橙色描边泛光、两侧卡压暗，状态胶囊「Heating · ready in 12 min」弹出；hold 54f 极缓推镜
issuesEn: The wide shot was a generic grey small-text dashboard, and the result card was just a big '1' in a grey tile, so the three steps had no visible outcome
The three close-ups (Deploy button, switch, flip counter) had no relation to the wide shot's content and read as three unrelated clips spliced together
The close-up background was the whole dashboard blown up and blurred into flat grey-white, and the controls looked flat
The result relied on an indigo outline and a '+1' badge; the answer was not bright enough
changesEn: Ember look with a fictional smart-heating app, Hearth: the wide shot is three room cards designed for the shot (120px light temperature readout, 270° dial, power button, Boost toggle), and orange only ever means 'heating'

The three close-ups are the centre card's own controls, redrawn at native size: 1) the power button presses and lights orange inside a machined bezel, 2) the Boost toggle flips right with a stretching knob and a two-layer flame, 3) the dial goes 19° to 22° as the arc sweeps, ticks light up and the 300px readout jumps

The three shots match: subject centred at the same scale, the same warm-black macro bokeh (rearranged per shot), a slight in-shot push, and step labels '01 POWER / 02 BOOST / 03 SET 22°' bottom-left that tie the triple cut into one flow

Rhythm keeps the 10f click structure of 4 still, 3 action, 3 still, with each state flipping at the action midpoint; after the third click a 7f poly(5) whip throws the last shot off left and the wide shot in from the right, with velocity-based horizontal motion blur
Result: the centre card springs up with an orange glowing outline while the side cards dim, and a 'Heating · ready in 12 min' pill pops in; a 54f hold with a slow push
